narr.Aqua Kyoto Paris: W39 is not a trading week that can be read as demand. Aqua Kyoto Paris did not serve on five of the seven days: Monday 26, Tuesday 27, Thursday 29 and Friday 30 October recorded no live reservations at all and Wednesday 28 recorded one, each with a cluster of cancelled public bookings on the same date, which is the signature of a closed service. The restaurant traded on Saturday 31 October, 57 reservations and 149 covers, and Sunday 1 November, 44 and 100. The prior week lost Saturday 24 October the same way. A comparable closure happened last year but a week later, 2 to 5 November 2025, so the year ago week here kept six of its seven service days and the comparison is six days against two. Read the week as a closure, not a fall in demand. Google Ads delivered nothing. Impressions, clicks and cost are zero on all seven days, the account last served on 21 October, and that is now eleven consecutive dark days. All six delivering campaigns remain enabled, the other four were paused before the week, and change_event returns no rows for 22 October to 1 November. Paid Search sessions fell to 16 from 216, which confirms the outage from the site side. Google spend is nil against a prorated plan of 1,458 euros and no Google cost per booking is quoted. The booking tag has not recovered. On a consistent gross basis GA4 counted 0.43 create path bookings for every SevenRooms website booking this week, against 0.38 last week and 1.20 in the matched week last year, so GA4 is seeing about a third of what it used to and the 43 understates by roughly 2.3 times. That is seventeen days on from the 16 October break. GA4 bookings and SevenRooms bookings are different measures, gross against net, and are not a larger and smaller version of the same number. SevenRooms carries the demand read. Website bookings created, gross of cancellations so the weeks are comparable on settlement, were 100 against 110 in W38 and 169 a year ago, a fall of 9.1 per cent on the week and 40.8 per cent on the year with the room shut for five days. Google Reserve was 36 against 48 and 36 a year ago, and walk ins 17 against 66 and 30, and a walk in can only happen on a trading day so that fall is the closure. Meta held at 1,673 euros for 31 pixel bookings, a 53.96 euro cost per booking against 68.73 in W38, and it ran at full weight into five closed days. Users of 2,741 are up 17.4 per cent on the week, so site traffic did not fall, and the conversion rate of 1.57 per cent of users is a tagging artefact rather than a change in behaviour. Spend pacing is 53.2 per cent of the prorated plan for the week, Meta 99.3 per cent and Google nil.

Aqua Kyoto Paris: The venue did not serve on 26, 27, 29 and 30 October and served one booking on 28 October, so the week is two trading days against six in the year ago week. Google Ads has delivered nothing since 21 October and the booking tag still captures 0.43 of SevenRooms website bookings
